subject: add transition animation while the plot is being generated

messages.author: d0def6a2f188e6a9
messages.subject: add transition animation while the plot is being generated
parts:
Dear All
I wonder if there is a way to have a dynamic circular pattern with some text (or some type of transitional animation) displayed in the main panel while the figure is being generated behind the scene.

I'm dealing with a big data set and I applied several algorithms on the data before the figure can be generated, therefore it takes around 20 seconds before I see the figure.

I wish I could add some transition animation on the main panel while waiting for the plot (not only to change the alpha level)

Thanks for help

Xiao
